verdict.rationale: BigQuery's Iceberg managed tables keep data in customer-owned storage buckets in the open Iceberg format, readable by open-source and third-party engines. BigQuery also supports open table formats such as Iceberg, Delta and Hudi, and ODBC/JDBC drivers give programmatic read access to any table. That makes leaving feasible for data kept in these formats, but the evidence shows no general way to export all standard native tables in open formats. Missing for 10: documented export/extract of all native BigQuery tables to open file formats (e.g., Parquet/Avro/CSV), evidence covering export of non-table assets, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full migration out.
